hero_sub: We audit performance, security, design, testing and search visibility — measured first, then explained. Then we re-verify every fix until the board is green.
gap_h2: A report names the work. Readiness proves it.
gap_lead: Fahes records what checks observed, keeps incomplete areas visible, and re-checks fixes before calling them green.
gap_1d: Findings distinguish what a check measured from what was inferred.
gap_2d: A narrow re-check costs {reverifyCost, number} credits. The issue turns green only when its check passes.
gap_3d: When a check cannot run, its area shows what is missing. Platform failures are not charged.
proof_note: A degraded area never reads as a pass. If we could not run a check, the report says so and you are not charged for it.
areas_intro: Each area reports its own findings and cost. Checks below describe current coverage.
a_perf_d: Response-header checks for caching and compression
a_sec_d: Security headers and cookie flags; leaked credentials and known-vulnerable dependencies in attached source
a_des_d: In attached source: stylesheet weight, !important overuse, and color sprawl; broken images
a_seo_d: Title, description, viewport, canonical URL, headings, language, and image alt text
areas_note: {areaCount, plural, =5 {Five} other {#}} areas cost {individualCost, number} individually against {fullAuditCost, number} bundled. Complete coverage is always the cheapest route to complete coverage.
loop_h2: Red to green, one check at a time.
loop_1d: Submit a URL, a repository, or an archive.
loop_2d: Copy the remediation prompt into your coding agent.
loop_3d: {reverifyCost, number} credits, seconds. It passes or it stays red.
loop_4d: A fresh full re-audit returns an explicit go or no-go.
cta_lead: Enough to audit two or three areas of your real site and see real findings.
pricing_lead: Plan credits expire at renewal. Purchased top-ups never expire, and expiring credits are always spent first.
pricing_feature_concurrent_audits: {count, plural, one {# concurrent audit} other {# concurrent audits}}
pricing_cost_full_audit: Full audit, all {areaCount, plural, =5 {five} other {#}}, bundled
pricing_cost_note: Top-ups are paid-plan only. Platform faults, provider outages and internal errors refund or never debit.
report_h2: Not another score with no explanation.
report_intro: A finding carries what was measured, where it was found, and a deterministic prompt you can hand to your coding agent.
report_description: The response did not include a Cache-Control header, so browsers are not told how to cache this page.
report_prompt_text:
Fix the following performance issue.

Problem: Cache policy is missing
What was measured: The response did not include a Cache-Control header.
Where: GET https://shop.example/
Why it matters: Repeat visits may download the same page again instead of using a safe cached response.
Evidence: {"cache-control":null}

Make the smallest change that resolves this, and do not alter unrelated behaviour.
When you are done, state what you changed so the fix can be re-checked.
report_prompt_note: The prompt is assembled from the finding by a deterministic rule. It remains available when AI interpretation is unavailable.
readiness_intro: Every area must meet its published threshold, and the fresh audit must show no regressions against its baseline.
readiness_blocker_design: Design is below its published threshold.
readiness_blocker_seo: Search visibility regressed against the baseline.
readiness_no_measure: An area that could not be measured is a no-go, never a pass.
ai_h2: AI-assisted development still needs an independent check.
ai_body: AI coding tools can speed up the build. Fahes checks the result against deterministic criteria before it ships.
trust_ssrf_body: DNS answers are checked, the connected address is checked again, and every redirect is revalidated.
trust_readonly_body: Capabilities fetch pages and inspect responses or source files. They do not submit forms or write to the audited site.
trust_source_title: Attached source is temporary workspace data
trust_source_body: An attached repository or archive is extracted into a scan workspace that is destroyed when the scan exits, including failure and cancellation.
trust_retention_body: Report data follows plan retention and is warned about before removal. Source workspaces are cleaned up with the scan; those are separate lifecycles.
pricing_preview_lead: The credit schedule is fixed. Start with the free allocation, then spend only where your audit needs coverage.
pricing_preview_free_copy: Try the audit on your real site with the one-time free allocation.
pricing_preview_separate: credits for all {areaCount, plural, =5 {five} other {#}} areas bought separately
pricing_preview_bundle: credits for all {areaCount, plural, =5 {five} other {#}} in a full audit
faq_lead: What the audit reads, how its data is handled, and what a readiness decision means.
faq_readonly_answer: No. Audits are read-only: Fahes reads pages and inspects responses or supplied source files. It does not submit forms or write to the audited site.
faq_data_question: What happens to my scan data?
faq_data_answer: Source code is removed when the scan workspace closes, including after failure or cancellation. Reports have a separate plan-based retention period, with a warning before removal.
faq_ai_question: Can I audit a site or app built with AI coding tools?
faq_ai_answer: Yes. Fahes uses the same audit path for projects built with AI coding tools or any other method; it checks the resulting site or source.
faq_readiness_answer: Every area must meet its published threshold, and the fresh audit must show no regressions against the baseline. A blocked or unmeasurable area is named as a blocker, not hidden in a score.
faq_free_question: What can I do with the free credits?
faq_free_answer: The one-time {freeCredits, number}-credit allocation can cover two or three audit areas, so you can see real findings on your site. A full audit costs {fullAuditCost, number} credits.
faq_recheck_question: Do I need to pay for a full audit after every fix?
faq_recheck_answer: No. You can re-check one issue for {reverifyCost, number} credits. It turns green only when its check passes; otherwise it stays unresolved.
